notes.title: Free To Play
notes.notes: This game is going free soon.  No catches.  No other changes.

notes.title: Release on the 25th
notes.notes: Yup, really going to release!  Apologies for the long delay.

notes.title: Sorry For the Wait
notes.notes: In order to provide a better play experienced, I've decided to delay the release of [b]Eat Your Words[/b].  I am implementing additional game play features that will make the game more fun with better replayability.

notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes: [b]Eat Your Words[/b] will be released on [b]July 11th, 2018[/b], less than two weeks away!
